# GeoJSON

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A GeoJSON file, or any vector file DuckDB spatial reads (shapefile, GeoPackage…), as rows: `features` has one row per feature with its geometry; polygons, lines and points have one row per vertex, ready for a layer; `all` has every vertex row with a `kind` column. Wire a table with a `geom` column into `in` to read its geometry instead of a file.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "geojson", "name": "geojson", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "all"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Older projects
